parameters.$filter: @if(empty(outputs('AWG_-_CON_-_04_Compose_FlowId_From_Body')), concat('OriginalConversationId eq ''', triggerOutputs()?['body/conversationId'], ''' and Phase eq ''03-RDDRequestSent'''), concat('FlowId eq ''', outputs('AWG_-_CON_-_04_Compose_FlowId_From_Body'), ''' and Phase eq ''03-RDDRequestSent'''))

DEBUG_FULL.inputs:
@concat(
  'ConversationId: ', triggerOutputs()?['body/conversationId'],
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'FilterQuery: ', outputs('DEBUG_FilterQuery'),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'NewRDD_Raw: ', outputs('Calculate_WorkDate'),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'NewRDD_ISO: ', outputs('NewRDD_ISO'),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'GetItems_Count: ', string(length(body('Get_items')?['value'])),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'GetItems_FirstID: ', string(first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['ID'])
)

DEBUG_CREATE.inputs:
@concat(
  'ConversationId: ', triggerOutputs()?['body/conversationId'],
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'NewRDD: ', outputs('Calculate_WorkDate'),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'NewRDD_ISO: ', outputs('NewRDD_ISO'),
  decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
  'ShouldGoImmediate: ', string(greaterOrEquals(utcNow(), addDays(outputs('NewRDD_ISO'), -10)))
)

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hello team,

This consolidation request was received and validated, but the aligned Requested Delivery Date is still outside the 10-day window, so it will not be worked yet.

Tracking ID: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['ID']}
Flow ID: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['FlowId']}
Original subject: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['OriginalSubject']}
POs: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['POs']}
New RDD: @{outputs('NewRDD_ISO')}
Scheduled work date: @{formatDateTime(addDays(outputs('NewRDD_ISO'), -10), 'MM/dd/yyyy')}
Current phase: 03-RDDRequestSent — Pending 10 Days Out

No action is required today. This item will be picked up once it enters the 10-day window.

@{variables('SignatureHtml')}

Hello team,

An OSSGen AI response was received for a consolidation in flow, but the Requested Delivery Date could not be read from the table, so the request was not advanced automatically and needs to be reviewed manually.

Tracking ID: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['ID']}
Flow ID: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['FlowId']}
Original subject: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['OriginalSubject']}
POs: @{first(body('Get_items')?['value'])?['POs']}
RDD column index used: @{string(outputs('Compose_RDD_Index'))}
Raw value read: @{coalesce(outputs('Calculate_WorkDate'),'(empty)')}
Normalized value: @{coalesce(outputs('NewRDD_ISO'),'(empty)')}
Current phase: 03-RDDRequestSent (unchanged)

Please review the OSSGen AI reply and work this consolidation manually.

@{variables('SignatureHtml')}
